title: Baseline paths and invalid [baseline] tables
description: [baseline] path is resolved against the folder of Scan.toml, and --baseline-path against the current directory. --create-baseline creates a missing file and its folders. --baseline-path replaces [baseline] path for one run, with a warning. `invalid` checks the [baseline] table itself: wrong types, unknown keys, a URL or an empty path, and [baseline] written as a key. Needs scan 0.15.0+.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)

steps.name: --create-baseline from the case root
steps.note: Creates nested/baselines/scan.json, next to nested/Scan.toml, not in the case root, and creates the baselines folder.

steps.name: --create-baseline --baseline-path
steps.note: Warning: --baseline-path=custom.json overrides [baseline] path = "baselines/scan.json" in Scan.toml. Creates nested/custom.json.

steps.note: 2 errors, each at its line and column. Nothing is scanned.
